method: single-object (letter paper, portrait, 0.2794m) at 2 hand-held distances - NOT the standard 3-distance person method (room too small for full-body framing)
spread_warning: spread > 10%: re-check the tape measurements and framing (calibrate.py would print this same warning) - likely hand-held paper tilt/angle imprecision, not a camera issue
caveat: treat perception.py distance/TTC numbers as approximate, not precision-verified
